recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a portrait-first browser game titled **Legend of the Hollow Grove**. Preserve the source mechanics: touch joystick movement in a top-down scrolling arena, rectangular obstacle collision, a start screen, a gate/summon action that triggers a short ritual, a boss encounter with chase/slash/projectile states, sword attacks that damage the boss only at close range, shield/parry timing that blocks damage and can stun, player hearts as HP, boss HP victory, failure/retry overlays, and mobile action buttons. Reinterpret those mechanics as a Zelda-like mythic overworld and sealed shrine trial: the player is a green-clad relic knight opening a dungeon gate, mossy shrine blocks replace buildings, harmless spirits replace NPCs, cursed relic bolts replace projectiles, and the Hollow Wyrm-Knight is the boss guardian. Use browser-native Canvas/CSS/JS, responsive portrait UI, approved catalog fonts/audio/GIF accents, authored procedural forest-shrine motifs, and compact touch-friendly controls.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: top-down mobile action arena with pre-boss exploration, melee combat, parry defense, projectile avoidance, HP failure, and boss-defeat victory.
- objective: start the quest, roam the overworld/shrine field, activate the gate ritual, survive the Hollow Wyrm-Knight, and reduce boss HP to zero.
- input model: touch-first virtual joystick for movement; right-side action buttons for gate/sword/shield; desktop click support for action buttons remains present.
- core loop: move through a scrolling arena, avoid collision blocks, trigger the gate, attack when close, shield/parry timed boss hits, preserve hearts, retry or replay after terminal states.
- fail/friction state: player hearts reach zero from boss slash/projectile damage, showing a retry overlay; boss HP reaching zero shows victory overlay.

## Protected Mechanics
- Movement speed, joystick vector mapping, camera follow, collision rectangles, attack timing, attack range, parry active frames/cooldown, projectile speed/life/damage, boss HP/player HP, boss chase/slash/star/stun states, start/summon/boss/win/over transitions.

## Safe Theming Surfaces
HUD vocabulary, title/copy, colors, procedural canvas drawing, entity silhouettes, particle colors, background motifs, audio URLs from approved catalogs, feedback GIFs from approved catalog, mobile CSS hierarchy, and documentation artifacts.
